description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's atomic push functionality, including setup, test cases, and hooks.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of Git repositories 'upstream' and 'workbench' for testing, configuring 'upstream' to warn on current branch pushes and adding 'upstream' as a remote in 'workbench'.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares two references in 'upstream' and 'workbench' repositories to verify they point to the same commit.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output of Git push status, extracting lines starting with 'To' and ' ! ', cleaning whitespace.
